Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure illustrates the internal operation of a hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell, showing the flow of reactants and charge carriers through three labeled components: the anode (left), the proton exchange membrane (center), and the cathode (right). Hydrogen gas enters from the left and is oxidized at the anode, releasing electrons that travel through an external circuit — symbolized by a resistor labeled Electric power at the top — and protons that migrate through the proton exchange membrane toward the cathode. At the cathode, the arriving protons and electrons combine with incoming oxygen to produce water, which exits at the lower right, while unused hydrogen exits at the lower left. This figure introduces the fuel cell as a device that converts the chemical energy of hydrogen oxidation directly into electrical energy through spatially separated half-reactions, with water as the sole byproduct.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Animate the electron flow: step through the fuel cell cycle showing H2 splitting at the anode, H+ ions crossing the proton exchange membrane, and electrons flowing through the external circuit to the cathode
- Slider for H2 feed rate: watch the arrow thickness on both the hydrogen inlet and the current path thicken or thin proportionally
- Toggle between the fully labeled diagram and a clean-flow schematic: collapse all text annotations to expose just the particle and electron flow arrows

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, chapter 1

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

} else if (type === 'H2O') { g.circle(16).center(0, 0).fill('#e53935').stroke({ width: 1, color: '#b71c1c' }); g.circle(12).center(-8, 6).fill('#fff').stroke({ width: 1, color: '#ccc' }); g.circle(12).center(8, 6).fill('#fff').stroke({ width: 1, color: '#ccc' }); } return g; } function createPath(points) { let totalLength = 0; const segments = []; for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) { const dx = points[i + 1].x - points[i].x; const dy = points[i + 1].y - points[i].y; const len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); totalLength += len; segments.push({ dx, dy, len, startP: points[i] }); } return function (t) { if (t >= 1) return points[points.length - 1]; const targetLength = t * totalLength; let curLength = 0; for (let i = 0; i < segments.length; i++) { if (curLength + segments[i].len >= targetLength) { const segT = (targetLength - curLength) / segments[i].len; return { x: segments[i].startP.x + segments[i].dx * segT, y: segments[i].startP.y + segments[i].dy * segT }; } curLength += segments[i].len; } return points[points.length - 1]; } } let activeParticles = []; function addParticle(type, pathPoints, duration, onComplete) { const node = createParticleNode(type); particlesLayer.add(node); activeParticles.push({ g: node, pos: createPath(pathPoints), dur: duration, t: 0, onComplete: onComplete }); } function triggerReaction() { const startY1 = 220 + Math.random() * 15; const startY2 = 245 + Math.random() * 15; const cathodeY = 230 + Math.random() * 140; // H2 pairs to Anode addParticle('H2', [{ x: 90, y: startY1 }, { x: 280, y: startY1 }, { x: 310, y: startY1 }], 2000, () => { addParticle('H+', [{ x: 310, y: startY1 }, { x: 465, y: cathodeY - 12 }], 3000); addParticle('H+', [{ x: 310, y: startY1 }, { x: 465, y: cathodeY + 12 }], 3000); addParticle('e-', [{ x: 310, y: startY1 }, { x: 335, y: startY1 }, { x: 335, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: cathodeY - 12 }], 3000); addParticle('e-', [{ x: 310, y: startY1 }, { x: 335, y: startY1 }, { x: 335, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: cathodeY + 12 }], 3000); }); addParticle('H2', [{ x: 90, y: startY2 }, { x: 280, y: startY2 }, { x: 310, y: startY2 }], 2000, () => { addParticle('H+', [{ x: 310, y: startY2 }, { x: 465, y: cathodeY - 24 }], 3000); addParticle('H+', [{ x: 310, y: startY2 }, { x: 465, y: cathodeY + 24 }], 3000); addParticle('e-', [{ x: 310, y: startY2 }, { x: 335, y: startY2 }, { x: 335, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: cathodeY - 24 }], 3000); addParticle('e-', [{ x: 310, y: startY2 }, { x: 335, y: startY2 }, { x: 335, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: cathodeY + 24 }], 3000); }); // O2 to Cathode addParticle('O2', [{ x: 710, y: cathodeY }, { x: 520, y: cathodeY }, { x: 465, y: cathodeY }], 5000, () => { addParticle('H2O', [{ x: 465, y: cathodeY - 10 }, { x: 520, y: cathodeY - 10 }, { x: 520, y: 385 }, { x: 710, y: 385 }], 2500); addParticle('H2O', [{ x: 465, y: cathodeY + 15 }, { x: 520, y: cathodeY + 15 }, { x: 520, y: 400 }, { x: 710, y: 400 }], 2500); }); } function triggerUnreactedH2() { const startY = 220 + Math.random() * 40; addParticle('H2', [{ x: 90, y: startY }, { x: 280, y: startY }, { x: 280, y: 385 }, { x: 90, y: 385 }], 4500); } function drawFlowArrows(rate) { arrowsLayer.clear(); const thick = 2 + 3 * rate; const headWid = 5 + 3 * rate; const headLen = 8 + 4 * rate; function makeArrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color) { const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1; const len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); const nx = dx / len, ny = dy / len; arrowsLayer.line(x1, y1, x2 - nx * headLen, y2 - ny * headLen).stroke({ width: thick, color: color, linecap: 'round' }); const px1 = x2 - nx * headLen - ny * headWid; const py1 = y2 - ny * headLen + nx * headWid; const px2 = x2 - nx * headLen + ny * headWid; const py2 = y2 - ny * headLen - nx * headWid; arrowsLayer.polygon(`${x2},${y2} ${px1},${py1} ${px2},${py2}`).fill(color); } makeArrow(110, 235, 170, 235, '#fff'); makeArrow(170, 385, 110, 385, '#fff'); makeArrow(690, 235, 630, 235, '#fff'); makeArrow(630, 385, 690, 385, '#fff'); makeArrow(335, 140, 335, 95, '#fff'); makeArrow(465, 95, 465, 140, '#fff'); } // --- Animation Loop & State --- let feedRate = 1.0; let demoMode = 'continuous'; // 'continuous' | 'stepped' let timeSinceLastReaction = 2000; let timeSinceLastUnreacted = 0; const baseReactionInterval = 2500; const baseUnreactedInterval = 1800; let lastTime = null; function resetSystem() { activeParticles.forEach(p => p.g.remove()); activeParticles = []; staticNodes.clear(); } function loop(time) { if (!lastTime) lastTime = time; let dt = time - lastTime; lastTime = time; if (dt > 50) dt = 16; // Prevent jumps if backgrounded const scaledDt = dt * feedRate; if (demoMode === 'continuous') { timeSinceLastReaction += scaledDt; if (timeSinceLastReaction >= baseReactionInterval) { triggerReaction(); timeSinceLastReaction = 0; } timeSinceLastUnreacted += scaledDt; if (timeSinceLastUnreacted >= baseUnreactedInterval) { triggerUnreactedH2(); timeSinceLastUnreacted = 0; } } for (let i = activeParticles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = activeParticles[i]; p.t += scaledDt / p.dur; if (p.t >= 1) { const finalPos = p.pos(1); p.g.remove(); activeParticles.splice(i, 1); if (p.onComplete) p.onComplete(finalPos); } else { const cur = p.pos(p.t); p.g.transform({ translateX: cur.x, translateY: cur.y }); } } requestAnimationFrame(loop); } // --- Interaction Handlers --- window.update_feedRate = function (v) { feedRate = v; drawFlowArrows(v); }; window.toggle_cleanFlow = function (on) { if (on) { labelLayer.animate(300).opacity(0); } else { labelLayer.animate(300).opacity(1); } }; // --- Step Player --- const demoSteps = [ { narration: "The continuous cycle generates electric power from hydrogen and oxygen.", feedRate: 1.0, cleanFlow: false }, { narration: "Hydrogen gas (H₂) enters the cell and flows toward the anode.", feedRate: 1.0, cleanFlow: true }, { narration: "At the anode, H₂ splits into protons (H⁺) and electrons (e⁻).", feedRate: 1.0, cleanFlow: true }, { narration: "Protons migrate through the membrane while electrons flow through the external circuit.", feedRate: 1.0, cleanFlow: true }, { narration: "At the cathode, incoming oxygen (O₂) combines with arriving protons and electrons to form water.", feedRate: 1.0, cleanFlow: true }, { narration: "The continuous cycle generates electric power with water as the only byproduct.", feedRate: 1.5, cleanFlow: false } ]; let currentStep = 0; window.runStep = function (stepIdx) { resetSystem(); if (stepIdx === 0) { demoMode = 'continuous'; timeSinceLastReaction = baseReactionInterval; } else if (stepIdx === 1) { demoMode = 'stepped'; addParticle('H2', [{ x: 90, y: 260 }, { x: 310, y: 260 }], 1500, (p) => { staticNodes.add(createParticleNode('H2').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y })); }); } else if (stepIdx === 2) { demoMode = 'stepped'; const g = createParticleNode('H2').transform({ translateX: 310, translateY: 260 }); staticNodes.add(g); setTimeout(() => { if (currentStep !== 2) return; g.remove(); addParticle('H+', [{ x: 310, y: 260 }, { x: 310, y: 240 }], 500, p => staticNodes.add(createParticleNode('H+').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y }))); addParticle('H+', [{ x: 310, y: 260 }, { x: 310, y: 280 }], 500, p => staticNodes.add(createParticleNode('H+').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y }))); addParticle('e-', [{ x: 310, y: 260 }, { x: 325, y: 230 }], 500, p => staticNodes.add(createParticleNode('e-').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y }))); addParticle('e-', [{ x: 310, y: 260 }, { x: 325, y: 290 }], 500, p => staticNodes.add(createParticleNode('e-').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y }))); }, 800); } else if (stepIdx === 3) { demoMode = 'stepped'; addParticle('H+', [{ x: 310, y: 240 }, { x: 465, y: 240 }], 2500, p => staticNodes.add(createParticleNode('H+').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y }))); addParticle('H+', [{ x: 310, y: 280 }, { x: 465, y: 280 }], 2500, p => staticNodes.add(createParticleNode('H+').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y }))); addParticle('e-', [{ x: 325, y: 230 }, { x: 335, y: 230 }, { x: 335, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: 240 }], 2500, p => staticNodes.add(createParticleNode('e-').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y }))); addParticle('e-', [{ x: 325, y: 290 }, { x: 335, y: 290 }, { x: 335, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: 70 }, { x: 465, y: 280 }], 2500, p => staticNodes.add(createParticleNode('e-').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y }))); } else if (stepIdx === 4) { demoMode = 'stepped'; const h1 = createParticleNode('H+').transform({ translateX: 465, translateY: 240 }); const h2 = createParticleNode('H+').transform({ translateX: 465, translateY: 280 }); const e1 = createParticleNode('e-').transform({ translateX: 475, translateY: 230 }); const e2 = createParticleNode('e-').transform({ translateX: 475, translateY: 290 }); staticNodes.add(h1); staticNodes.add(h2); staticNodes.add(e1); staticNodes.add(e2); addParticle('O2', [{ x: 710, y: 260 }, { x: 465, y: 260 }], 1500, (p) => { const o2 = createParticleNode('O2').transform({ translateX: p.x, translateY: p.y }); staticNodes.add(o2); setTimeout(() => { if (currentStep !== 4) return; h1.remove(); h2.remove(); e1.remove(); e2.remove(); o2.remove(); addParticle('H2O', [{ x: 465, y: 240 }, { x: 520, y: 240 }, { x: 520, y: 385 }, { x: 710, y: 385 }], 2000); addParticle('H2O', [{ x: 465, y: 280 }, { x: 520, y: 280 }, { x: 520, y: 405 }, { x: 710, y: 405 }], 2000); }, 600); }); } else if (stepIdx === 5) { demoMode = 'continuous'; timeSinceLastReaction = baseReactionInterval; } }; window.updateStepUI = function () { document.getElementById('demoNarration').textContent = demoSteps[currentStep].narration; document.getElementById('stepLabel').textContent = `Step ${currentStep + 1} / ${demoSteps.length}`; const state = demoSteps[currentStep]; document.getElementById('feedRateInput').value = state.feedRate; document.getElementById('feedRateVal').value = state.feedRate; update_feedRate(state.feedRate); document.getElementById('cleanFlowInput').checked = state.cleanFlow; toggle_cleanFlow(state.cleanFlow); runStep(currentStep); }; window.prevStep = function () { if (currentStep > 0) { currentStep--; updateStepUI(); } }; window.nextStep = function () { if (currentStep < demoSteps.length - 1) { currentStep++; updateStepUI(); } }; // Initialize drawFlowArrows(1.0); updateStepUI(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
